stage: independent initial interpretation before canonical reef-middle technical inspection

observations.original: The exported S snapshot reads as a blue continuous raised reef strip with a large plain blue surface and dark lower wall. Two small purple foreground stalks flank one teal rear stalk. Facets are sharp and sparse; the colored pieces read as pegs rather than soft marine growth. The actual original collection has a 48-vertex finite asymmetric core, three stem/tip pairs and one low polyp, all owned by one static root.
observations.target: The fixed target proposes a crafted blue/cyan reef with softened rock masses and clustered hollow green/teal and purple tubes. Large openings, thick softly rounded rims, gentle taper and grouped heights give readable marine identity. The base has varied local rock forms, small rounded accents and broad lit surfaces rather than one blank slab. Target caustic-like white lines, bright rim glints and a visibly expanded composition are style suggestions, not proof of geometry, registration or ports.
observations.styleReference: The plant reference favors broad, legible volume, saturated local colors, warm light edges and clean value separation. It remains stylized and faceted in places rather than uniformly smooth or photorealistic.
observations.nativeSource: After activating only S33_PROP_reef-edge.001 in memory, the core spans x[-0.5,0.5], y[-0.38,0.38], z[0,0.448812753]. Its two finite ends share the authored eight-point asymmetric, locally concave Y/Z section. Ground contact is a finite rectangle; this is not a whole-cell floor. Decoration stays inside the nominal cell and rises to z0.6599999666; declared gameplay height is0.68. Initial unactivated world matrices were stale and are retained under an explicitly invalid filename; only the activated inspection is authoritative.

proposedVisibleOutcomes: Replace the sparse peg-like reading with a coherent soft coral/reef composition using substantial hollow or similarly legible marine forms; preserve the teal/green and purple palette families without locking part counts.
Give the blue reef body crafted local volume and a readable softened silhouette while its finite functional cross-sections and ground contacts remain exact.
Keep the main shape groups and openings legible at logical128 and phone32 cell sizes; avoid tiny bright noise, merged dark cavities and isolated floating pieces.
Use soft highlights and separated cyan/blue values that remain coherent in all four rotations; avoid directional ground shadows, black lower bands, white edge halos and clipping.
limits: No candidate was examined or approved. Technical family adoption follows only after this saved independent interpretation.
